part.text:
## Answer: Yes — it was `.rgignore` (and before that, `.xrepignore`)

**The commit that establishes the answer: `cc90511ab29d3c37e873acac0fd80f90473f54bb`** — "Switch from .rgignore to .ignore." (Andrew Gallant, 2016-09-23)

Commit message:

> ```
> Switch from .rgignore to .ignore.
>
> But don't actually remove support for .rgignore until the next semver
> bump.
>
> Note that this puts us in line with the silver searcher:
> https://github.com/ggreer/the_silver_searcher/pull/974
>
> Fixes #40
> ```

Supporting diff hunks from that commit:

`src/ignore.rs` — `.ignore` is added alongside the pre-existing `.rgignore`:
```diff
 const IGNORE_NAMES: &'static [&'static str] = &[
     ".gitignore",
+    ".ignore",
     ".rgignore",
 ];
```

`README.md`:
```diff
-The above command also respects all `.rgignore` files, including in parent
-directories. `.rgignore` files can be used when `.gitignore` files are
-insufficient. In all cases, `.rgignore` patterns take precedence over
+The above command also respects all `.ignore` files, including in parent
+directories. `.ignore` files can be used when `.gitignore` files are
+insufficient. In all cases, `.ignore` patterns take precedence over
 `.gitignore`.
```

And a new test was added in `tests/tests.rs` next to the existing `.rgignore` test:
```diff
+sherlock!(ignore_generic, "Sherlock", ".", |wd: WorkDir, mut cmd: Command| {
+    wd.create(".ignore", "sherlock\n");
+    wd.assert_err(&mut cmd);
+});
```

### Bonus: an even earlier name

Two prior commits show the name history goes back further, to when the tool itself was called `xrep`:

- `065c44998092906746f6585090bafbf36d98342b` — "File path filtering works and is pretty fast." (2016-08-27) introduced the original custom ignore file as **`.xrepignore`**, e.g. `builder.add_path(id.path.join(".xrepignore"))` and `$HOME/.xrepignore`.
- `a744ec133d12e0c8d8e8b0486cd92e2b60ad61e6` — "Rename xrep to ripgrep." (2016-09-08) renamed it to `.rgignore`:
  ```diff
   const IGNORE_NAMES: &'static [&'static str] = &[
       ".gitignore",
       ".agignore",
  -    ".xrepignore",
  +    ".rgignore",
   ];
  ```

So the progression was `.xrepignore` → `.rgignore` → `.ignore`. Note `.rgignore` was never fully dropped — at the pinned commit it still exists as a ripgrep-specific custom ignore filename (`crates/core/flags/hiargs.rs:916`: `builder.add_custom_ignore_filename(".rgignore");`), applied in addition to `.ignore`.

No files were modified.
